content.text: Fighting the first wave. I'm trying to keep my kills in one spot so the debris piles up.

Two kills so far, but the debris doesn't seem to have settled into a pile yet. Going after the next enemy to the west.
Hit two enemies at once and knocked them toward the northwest corner. I'll try to finish them there so the debris piles up in the corner.
HP is down to 36: their hits keep interrupting my standing kicks. Switching to dash-kicks, which have been landing reliably.
HP is at 12 and I'm surrounded, so I'm breaking away east along the back wall.
I died in the first box after 5 kills and escaped no boxes: my standing kicks kept getting cut off by enemy hits, and the debris never piled high enough to climb.
